name: Maspeth Gas Holder No. 1 (Brooklyn Union Gas, Maspeth Avenue)
shape_note: Built 1927, taken out of service 1992, imploded 15 July 2001 (Wikipedia). Height 401 ft and capacity 15 million cubic feet from Controlled Demolition Inc. Diameter estimated: 67 m from capacity / height as a plain cylinder (a lower bound: the 401 ft includes the guide frame). Position is the article's single coordinate for the pair, estimated to some tens of metres; the other holder is placed beside it. End year 2001 (July).

name: Maspeth Gas Holder No. 2 (Brooklyn Union Gas, Maspeth Avenue)
